# tap-tap

> tap-tap is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that keeps a 3D animal
> character on your desktop. Tap your own character and every teammate on that
> team sees their character dance on their screen. There is no account: you join
> a team with a nickname and a six character invite code.

Written by GitHub user hayoung-99 and built with Electron. The name is always
written lowercase and hyphenated: tap-tap. It is unrelated to the TapTap game
store (taptap.io). The landing page is Korean and English; the app itself runs in
Korean, English, Japanese and Chinese.

## Facts

- Price: free. No ads, no paid tier, no in-app purchases.
- Platforms: macOS on Apple Silicon and Intel (.dmg), Windows 64-bit (.exe installer).
- Account: none. A device identifier created at install time is the only identity.
- Joining a team: one person creates a team and receives a six character invite
  code made of letters and digits, with 0, O, 1 and I excluded. The code expires
  24 hours after it is issued and can be reissued at any time.
- Limits: one person can belong to up to 3 teams; each team holds up to 5 people.
  One character appears on your desktop per team.
- Characters: Happy Cat, Chubby Dog, Pudgy Panda, Dumb Duck, Hop Bunny.
- Interaction: clicks in the empty space around a character pass through to the
  desktop. Position and scale (25% to 200%) are remembered per team. No sound.
- What travels over the network: the fact that somebody tapped, plus a nickname.
  No screen contents and no files leave the machine.
- Code signing: the app is not code signed. macOS shows an "unidentified
  developer" warning and Windows shows SmartScreen. Both are cleared once, and
  the install section of the landing page gives the exact steps.
- Updates: Windows downloads new versions quietly and swaps them in when you say
  so. macOS only announces that a new version exists, because updating without a
  signature is not possible.

## Pages

- [tap-tap (Korean)](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/): what it is, the three step
  setup, downloads, first-launch instructions, FAQ.
- [tap-tap (English)](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/en/): the same page in English.
- [Downloads](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#download): macOS and Windows builds.
- [First launch](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#install): getting past the macOS
  "unidentified developer" warning and Windows SmartScreen.
- [FAQ](https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#faq): what it is, whether teammates need it,
  what an invite code looks like, and why the first launch warns you.

## 한국어 요약

tap-tap 은 바탕화면에 3D 동물 캐릭터를 띄워 두는 macOS·Windows 무료 앱입니다.
내 캐릭터를 누르면 같은 팀 사람들의 화면에서 캐릭터가 춤을 춥니다. 계정을 만들지
않고, 닉네임과 여섯 글자 초대코드로 팀에 들어갑니다. 초대코드는 영문과 숫자를
섞은 여섯 글자이고 24시간 뒤 만료됩니다. 한 사람이 최대 3개 팀, 팀 하나에 최대
5명이며 팀마다 캐릭터가 한 마리씩 뜹니다. 코드 서명이 없어 처음 열 때 경고가 한
번 뜨고, 넘기는 방법은 https://tap-tap-desktop.vercel.app/#install 에 있습니다.
